description: This file contains functions and classes for parsing and handling media codec information, including codec string parsing for av1, h264, h265, vp9, and vp09 formats, as well as functions for retrieving codec names and stream info output operators.

classes.name: SbMediaMasteringMetadata
classes.description: Structure representing mastering metadata for media.

classes.name: SbMediaColorMetadata
classes.description: Structure representing color metadata for media.

classes.name: SbMediaVideoSampleInfo
classes.description: Structure containing video sample information including stream info.

classes.name: SbMediaAudioSampleInfo
classes.description: Structure containing audio sample information including stream info.

methods.name: hex_to_int
methods.description: Converts a hex character to its integer value.

methods.name: ReadOneDigitHex
methods.description: Reads a single hex digit from string and outputs its value.

methods.name: ReadDecimalUntilDot
methods.description: Reads decimal number from string until '.' or end.

methods.name: ReadTwoDigitDecimal
methods.description: Reads two digit decimal number from string.

methods.name: VerifyFormat
methods.description: Checks if a format string matches a reference pattern.

methods.name: VerifyFormatStrictly
methods.description: Checks if a format string exactly matches a reference pattern.

methods.name: ParseAv1Info
methods.description: Parses AV1 codec string into profile, level, bit depth, and IDs.

methods.name: ParseH264Info
methods.description: Parses H264 codec string into profile and level.

methods.name: ParseH265Info
methods.description: Parses H265 codec string into profile and level.

methods.name: ParseVp09Info
methods.description: Parses VP9 codec string into profile, level, bit depth, and IDs.

methods.name: ParseVp9Info
methods.description: Parses VP9 codec string into profile and bit depth.

methods.name: ParseVideoCodec
methods.description: Determines codec type and parses associated info from string.
